items.title: Pay piano service invoice
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, die Rechnung binnen 20 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum zu bezahlen.
items.computation: Start of period = invoice date 19.11.2026 (Rechnungsdatum). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (19.11.2026) is not counted, so counting begins 20.11.2026 as day 1. A 20-day period therefore ends on day 20, which is 20.11.2026 + 19 days = 09.12.2026 (November has 30 days: 20+19=39 → 39-30=9 → 9 December). 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 09.12.2026.
